app.title: GhostStake
app.description: Stake, borrow against it, and take a position — without unwinding.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.body: This link does not point at a market, a round or a page. If someone shared it, the address in it may have been cut short.

routeError.title: This page could not be shown
routeError.body: The app hit an error drawing this screen. Nothing about your positions has changed — a page failing to render cannot move funds.

globalError.title: The app could not start
globalError.body: Nothing about your positions has changed — a page failing to render cannot move funds.

network.wrongWithWallet: <lead>Wrong network.</lead> GhostStake is deployed on {expected} — your wallet is on {actual}.
network.couldNotSwitch: Your wallet could not switch networks.

explorer.newTab: (opens the explorer in a new tab)

misconfigured.title: This deployment is misconfigured
misconfigured.body: It was built with {count, plural, one {a setting} other {settings}} the app cannot use, so it is not running rather than showing figures read from the wrong place. Nothing on chain is affected.
misconfigured.rebuild: These are read when the app is built, so fixing one means rebuilding it.
